rnaseq-de.limitations: PyDESeq2 worker count is explicitly bounded to one by default so small CPU workbenches do not spawn a process per host CPU. SCIENTIFIC_CLAWBIO_CPUS may be increased to match the instance allocation; statistical methods are unchanged.

scrna-orchestrator.limitations: Local Scanpy/Leiden and Scrublet doublet detection are installed. Optional CellTypist annotation/model downloads are not configured; use existing hosted annotation Apps where appropriate and do not silently invent cell labels.

article-data-fetcher.limitations: Headless adapter uses the upstream public API with non_interactive=True. Requires an explicit identifier and file-type selection; inspect the paper's data-availability statement first. External repositories may need access or be unavailable. Demo mode is not enabled because the upstream demo prompts on stdin.

fine-mapping.limitations: Only the upstream Wakefield ABF path without LD is installed. Use --sumstats without --ld; never describe this as SuSiE or multi-signal LD-aware fine mapping. SuShiE/JAX and the upstream SuSiE demo are not included.

claw-methylation-cycle.limitations: Upstream requires --input even with --demo. For a demonstration pass the installed skills/claw-methylation-cycle/demo_input.txt as an absolute --input. These genotype-derived heuristic scores are not measured enzyme activity or evidence for supplementation.

locuscompare-region-render.limitations: UKB-PPP supporting modules are bundled because the upstream renderer imports them, but authenticated Synapse/UKB retrieval is not configured or advertised. Use accessible public eQTL/GWAS sources; the corresponding network/data dependencies still apply.

ld-1000g-region-compute.limitations: The image includes PLINK 1.9. A real run still requires compatible population/reference data and access to the public 1000 Genomes service. Reference-data downloads are not bundled.

struct-predictor.guidance: Use the existing scientific-gateway and model-specific skills. Discover the caller's model schema, then invoke the hosted model through MCP or /opt/bionemo/invoke-native.py or invoke-scientific-batch.py. Do not install Boltz or download weights in the CPU LibreChat container. Preserve chain identities, MSA requirements, structure and confidence artifacts. Confidence scores do not establish experimental accuracy or binding affinity; do not repeat the upstream numerical pLDDT-to-Angstrom claim.

cell-detection.guidance: Discover cellpose-cpsam-v2 and its exact native input schema. Use the existing native file helper with real caller-owned image bytes and validate the returned masks, object counts and overlays. If the App is unavailable, explain that blocker; do not silently substitute synthetic demo segmentation or install a second GPU model in LibreChat.

scrna-embedding.guidance: Discover scvi-scanvi and its current API/schema before submitting h5ad data. Preserve raw counts, feature/cell identities, batch labels, seed and held-out labels; publish the returned latent representation and annotations. Missing access or an undeployed App is a blocker, not permission to claim an embedding. Use scrna-orchestrator for supported local QC and downstream analysis. Do not install a second GPU training stack in LibreChat.
